title: Top 7 Cash Flow Forecasting and Scenario Planning Software That Integrates With Accounting Software (2026, Reviewed and Compared)
summary: Compare 7 cash flow forecasting and scenario planning platforms that integrate with accounting software, and what to test in a demo for your ERP.
body_markdown:
**Updated November 2026**


The best cash flow forecasting and scenario planning software that integrates with accounting software is the one with a native connector for your system and a model where scenarios reach cash. Seven platforms stand out: Abacum, Anaplan, Cube, Datarails, Planful, Vena and Workday Adaptive Planning. They differ on how actuals arrive, whether the work stays in Excel, and how far a scenario reaches across the three statements.


Abacum is the AI-native FP&A platform finance trusts, and the business planning platform the whole company runs on. It runs on one governed layer of data, logic and context: data is the what, logic is the how, context is the why.


## Key takeaways


-


Start with your accounting system. Name it, then ask each vendor to show the connector live.


-


Actuals should arrive through an automated connection, not an export.


-


A scenario is only useful if it reaches the cash line, so change one assumption and watch all three statements.


-


Decide whether you want to keep working in Excel or move to a dedicated modeling layer.


-


Ask who runs the rollout and how long the first live forecast takes.

## What to look for in cash flow forecasting software that integrates with accounting software


1.


**A native connector for your system.** Look for named support for your ERP or accounting software, such as NetSuite, SAP S/4HANA, Sage Intacct, Xero or QuickBooks, and ask whether more than one system can feed the same model.


2.


**Automated refresh.** Actuals should arrive through a connection, not a CSV export.


3.


**Statement integration.** The P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement should update together and trace back to the transaction.


4.


**Scenario reach.** A scenario should flow through all three statements without manual links.


5.


**Spreadsheet fit.** Decide whether you want to keep working in Excel or move to a dedicated modeling layer.


6.


**Rollout and security.** Ask who runs the rollout and which certifications are current.


For a closer look at ERP connections and scenario planning, see our guide to[cash flow forecasting and scenario planning software with ERP integration](https://www.abacum.ai/blog/best-cash-flow-forecasting-scenario-planning-software-erp-integration) .


## The seven platforms


### Abacum: three statements and scenarios fed by your accounting system


Abacum builds the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow statement from live ERP actuals and keeps cash forecasts and scenarios in the same connected model. Implementation is finance-owned and runs six to nine weeks, depending on data complexity, entity count and workflows, guided by in-house FP&A experts. Abacum connects to 700+ integrations, including NetSuite, SAP S/4HANA, SAP Business ByDesign, Sage Intacct, Xero and QuickBooks, through native, automated connections. Multi-entity roll-ups use a dimension-based model, with currency translated at the FX rates you set.


**Best for:** finance teams running multi-entity, multi-location planning that want accounting data, cash and scenarios in one connected model.


### Anaplan


Anaplan is a connected-planning platform for teams that plan across finance, sales, supply chain and HR. Its integrated financial statements link the P&L, balance sheet and cash flow, and it adds AI-assisted scenario modeling ([anaplan.com](https://www.anaplan.com/) ).


**Best for:** teams connecting planning across finance, sales, supply chain and HR.


### Cube


Cube keeps live actuals, assumptions and scenarios maintained together, and supports direct and indirect cash flow methods alongside scenario modeling. It works with Excel and Google Sheets ([cubesoftware.com](https://www.cubesoftware.com/) ).


**Best for:** teams that want direct and indirect cash flow methods alongside scenario modeling.


### Datarails


Datarails is an Excel-native financial operating system that keeps full Excel functionality. It describes real-time bank connections that give live bank-to-dashboard cash visibility, and 600+ integrations ([datarails.com](https://www.datarails.com/) ).


**Best for:** teams that want live bank-to-dashboard cash visibility alongside Excel.


### Planful


Planful unifies close, planning and reporting, and includes a 13-week cash flow module with AP, AR and payroll inputs ([planful.com](https://www.planful.com/) ). Comparing Abacum and Planful? See[Abacum vs Planful](https://www.abacum.ai/compare/vs-planful) .


**Best for:** finance teams that need a structured 13-week treasury forecast.


### Vena


Vena delivers Excel-native, Microsoft-native planning with workflow that runs through Microsoft 365, Teams and Power BI. It supports direct and indirect cash flow methods, with weekly, monthly or daily planning intervals.


**Best for:** teams that want driver-based cash modeling inside an Excel-based process.


### Workday Adaptive Planning


Workday Adaptive Planning delivers finance-led planning tied into the Workday HR and finance ecosystem. Its in-memory calculation refreshes plans quickly, and it works with any ERP or GL data source ([workday.com](https://www.workday.com/en-us/products/adaptive-planning/overview.html) ). Comparing Abacum and Adaptive? See[Abacum vs Adaptive](https://www.abacum.ai/compare/vs-adaptive) .


**Best for:** organizations already invested in the Workday ecosystem.

We compared each platform on connector coverage, refresh, statement integration, scenario reach, spreadsheet fit and rollout, using each vendor's own published materials. Test every tool against your own accounting system.


## How Abacum connects accounting data to cash and scenarios


Our core view is that planning should shorten the distance between a question and a decision. When your accounting system feeds one connected model, a scenario answers the question the same day it is asked.


-


**One plan the whole business runs on.** Finance, reporting and budgeting share a single source of truth, so every team works from the same numbers and every version reconciles.


-


**Scenarios that reach cash.** Base, bull and bear cases are built off the same base version. Scenario Studio works backward from a target: you set the outcome and limits on any input, and goal seek finds the inputs that get there, with every assumption visible and every adjustment auditable.


-


**Planning at the speed of the business.** Abacum plans, forecasts and reports at weekly granularity, so you can steer the business every week instead of reporting on it every quarter, and answer the board's question the same day it is asked.


-


**AI you can defend in the boardroom.** AI-generated variance commentary flows into your narrative reporting and board pack, and every output links back to its source data and assumptions. AI does the production work and finance keeps the judgment. More than 85% of our customers use AI in Abacum every month (Abacum customer usage, October 2026).


-


**Spreadsheet flexibility without spreadsheet limits.** The Excel connector lets you import a budget or forecast as a version, or export your work to Excel and Google Sheets. See the[three-statement planning guide for CFOs](https://www.abacum.ai/blog/top-financial-planning-software-cash-flow-balance-sheet-three-statement-cfos) for how the pieces fit together.


### AI Modeler: describe the model, get a working model in minutes


Modeling no longer lives with one person. Tell AI Modeler what you need in plain language and get a working model in minutes. Add a product line or new variables by asking, even in models you inherited, and ask what drives any model, line by line, before the board meeting. The agent proposes, the planning engine calculates, and finance approves every change to reported figures. Nothing saves until you approve. AI Modeler is standard functionality included with the platform, with no credits and no meter.


### Abra: your whole business, one question away


Abra is the AI agent at the center of Abacum. Ask a question in plain language, such as what moved in the plan and why, and Abra works out what it needs, brings in the right expert agents (Modeler, Analyst, Reporter and Data Manager) and works from governed data, models and context. Agents propose, the planning engine calculates every number, and finance approves every change to reported figures. Nothing changes without approval, and every answer shows its work: the numbers, the assumptions and the model behind it.
